name: Chicken Kofta over Turmeric Rice with Cucumber, Tomato & Mint Raita

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and turmeric, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp turmeric, ground

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, halve, and mince onions. Place half in a large bowl and half in a medium bowl (set medium bowl aside for the raita).
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the large bowl along with the chicken, bread crumbs, and spices. Using your hands, mix until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
0.68 kg ground chicken
⅓ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tbsp garam masala
1 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a ¼-cup measure, form the chicken mixture into 18 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 4-inches long; place kofta on a large plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add kofta and pan-fry, rotating every 2-3 minutes, until browned and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, juice lemons into the medium bowl that was set aside for the raita.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumbers; add to the bowl.
Small dice tomatoes; add to the bowl.
Add yogurt, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the raita.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice, kofta, and raita between plates. Enjoy!
